name: Gerald G Wong
current_role: Founder, Chairman and General Manager (CEO), Shanghai Cambridge Industries Group (CIG; SSE 603083 / HKEX 6166)
profile: Gerald G Wong (黄钢) founded CIG in 2005-06, a Shanghai maker of optical modules and broadband/wireless equipment; it listed in Shanghai in 2017 and added a Hong Kong listing. Demand for high-speed optical modules for AI data centers has driven CIG's recent growth. He has been chairman and CEO since 2011.
interesting_fact: Before he became an entrepreneur, Wong spent 1984-2000 at AT&T Bell Labs and rose to vice president at Lucent Technologies. He has over 40 years in telecom.
deep_cut_fact: Before CIG, he co-founded Photon Bridge (光桥科技(中国)有限公司) in 2000. He holds both a bachelor's and a master's in electrical engineering and computer science from MIT, both conferred in June 1985.
notes: Relevant to the data-center angle because CIG makes 800G/1.6T optical modules. The best route is the IR email or the board secretary office (board secretary: Jin Zeqing). Wong is a US/MIT-trained engineer, so outreach in English should work.

name: Marciano Testa
current_role: Founder and controlling shareholder (chairman) of Agi / Agibank (NYSE: AGBK), Brazil
profile: Testa was born to a family of Italian immigrants in Rio Grande do Sul. In 1999, while still a college student, he started Agiplan as a credit distributor. It became a financeira in 2011 and a bank in 2016, when he bought Banco Gerador. Agibank serves underbanked Brazilians through a digital bank and in-person 'Smart Hubs'. It listed on the NYSE in February 2026, and he owns nearly two-thirds of it.
interesting_fact: He calls himself an 'empreendedor raiz' (grassroots entrepreneur). He began as a door-to-door 'vendedor pastinha' (briefcase salesman), selling credit to low-income people and retirees, and became a billionaire when Agibank listed on the NYSE.
deep_cut_fact: He started working at 8 to help his family. He opened his first business at 16 and sold it at 19, and calls that his 'primeiro MBA da vida real' (first real-life MBA). On legacy, he said he would like to be remembered as 'uma pessoa que transformou a própria história' (a person who transformed his own story).
notes: Glauber Correa has been Agi's CEO since 2021, and Testa sits on the board. Forbes' bio calls Testa 'founder, chairman and CEO', so his exact current title should be checked against the F-1 or 20-F. Some reports say he lives in the US. Press releases have also listed the agency address agibank@fsb.com.br as a press contact.
